title: Card titles clip descenders and muted text is unreadable
prompt: On the product cards (styles/card.css) the titles cut off the bottom of letters like g, y and p, and the muted metadata text is very hard to read on the white card. Fix both in styles/card.css. Text colours must reach WCAG AA (4.5:1) against the card background. Do not change any font-size, the grid in styles/layout.css, or the card background colour.
